::: {#def-single-world .theorem}
## Single-world independence

For every value $\mathbf v$ of $\mathbf V$, the counterfactuals

$$
\big\{\, V^{(\mathbf{pa}_V)} : V \in \mathbf V \,\big\}
$$

are mutually independent. Here $\mathbf{pa}_V$ is the sub-vector of $\mathbf v$ that gives values to the parents of $V$.
:::
